## Objective

Using retained development cases, determine whether coarse constrained fields miss identifiable local structure that existing HalfFlow/composition does not address at useful cost. Define a positive adoption criterion and scoped proposal before activating implementation.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: 10.1, FA-12. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `adaptive-extension decision and development fixtures`

## Acceptance criteria

1. Decision includes residual coherence, conditional information, separate-selection benefit and accuracy-versus-cost evidence.
2. Record pursue/defer/reject explicitly; a closed decision alone does not activate F02.
3. No sealed test leakage or mandatory global resolution doubling.

## Blocking prerequisites

- GN (`bd-01M2B1138PDKET2VY41A4WAWQ7`): FA-GN: Release the constrained nonlinear extension
- GC (`bd-01M2B113CPW0BDW29ZKR9VZ37H`): FA-GC: Complete complementary-method comparisons and adoption decisions

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

## Integration constraints

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces. Preserve strict compiler policy, current motion/HalfFlow defaults, dirty-tree ownership and frozen experiments. Keep Flashalign linear execution free of nonlinear setup and direct HalfFlow dependencies. Shared primitives migrate through their current owner with both-consumer evidence; do not merge method objectives.

## Conditional activation

This optional decision task is open but dependency-blocked by the required nonlinear and comparison milestones. When those prerequisites are complete, it may evaluate pursue/defer/reject from retained development evidence. It is excluded from required epic completion. Its implementation child remains explicitly BLOCKED until a positive scoped decision is recorded and that child is deliberately activated; closing a defer/reject decision does not authorize implementation.
